subject.title: memory_search: chokidar file watcher silently stops delivering events, index goes stale

question: Should unconfigured memory search get a default periodic rescan fallback when watcher events may be missed, or should periodic sync remain opt-in?
rationale: The bug is real, but the likely fix changes default background filesystem and embedding work for existing users, which repository policy treats as compatibility-sensitive product direction.

options.title: Accept default-on fallback after repair
options.body: Land the linked candidate or equivalent after any source-scoping bug is fixed and upgrade behavior is documented and proven.

options.title: Keep periodic sync opt-in
options.body: Leave `intervalMinutes` defaulting to `0` and improve docs, doctor guidance, or status warnings for operators who need a safety net.

options.title: Prefer watcher health recovery
options.body: Implement liveness/error recovery without changing the default interval behavior, at the cost of a more complex watcher-specific fix.

recommendation.title: Accept default-on fallback after repair
recommendation.body: Land the linked candidate or equivalent after any source-scoping bug is fixed and upgrade behavior is documented and proven.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent memory config/docs/runtime history makes this the best available owner for the default and upgrade-behavior choice.
